item: Robot HAT - custom PCB, bare board + assembly
exact part (MPN): microduck_robot_hat (this repository's own design; fab package electronics/robot-hat/out/fab/microduck_robot_hat-fab.zip)
identity status: in-house design, DRC verdict FAIL - quotable as an outline and stackup, not releasable as artwork
what to do now: QUOTE BARE BOARD FROM GERBERS ONLY. Design has open DRC failures; do not fabricate.
现在怎么做: 仅按 Gerber 报裸板价。设计尚有 DRC 问题，不要投产。
specification for the supplier: QUOTABLE NOW. Fab package: electronics/robot-hat/out/fab/microduck_robot_hat-fab.zip (Gerbers F/B.Cu, F/B.Mask, F/B.Silk, F/B.Paste, Edge.Cuts.GKO; PTH.drl + NPTH.drl; positions.csv; bom.csv). Board 65.0000 x 30.0000 mm bounding rectangle = 3.022506 sq in (routed outline 1939.24 mm2 = 3.005828 sq in), corner radius 3.5000 mm, 2 copper layers, FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper, green mask, white legend both sides. 28 placed parts, 21 nets, 859 tracks, 33 vias (0.800 mm pad / 0.300 mm drill), 97 drilled holes = 32.0926 per square inch. MINIMUM COPPER TRACK 0.1500 mm = 5.9055 mil, which is BELOW the 6 mil (0.1524 mm) floor that OSH Park and AdvancedPCB both publish and INSIDE JLCPCB's published 0.10/0.10 mm 2-layer process: quote it on a 4 mil process, or state the surcharge to hold 0.1500 mm on your standard one. Minimum drilled hole 0.3000 mm. Please quote (a) bare boards and (b) turnkey assembly against the shipped bom.csv and positions.csv, each at 3 / 100 / 1000 pieces. BE TOLD PLAINLY: this board's own design-rule check is FAIL - seven nets are unrouted (GND, HAT_1V8, HAT_3V3, SERVO_V, SPK_N, i2s3/DOUT, i2s3/WCLK) and one via pair violates hole-to-hole. We are asking for a price on this outline, stackup and drill count, not asserting the artwork is final.
open questions: Turnkey ASSEMBLY price at 3 / 100 / 1000 boards: CANNOT DETERMINE. Both fabs that gave a bare-board price quote bare board only; the two that advertise assembly (JLCPCB 'From $8.00', PCBWay '$29 free shipping for 1-20pcs assembly') publish a floor with no BOM attached. A quotation against the shipped bom.csv + positions.csv is the only thing that settles it - that request is drafted in RFQ.html. | Whether OSH Park bills the bounding rectangle (3.022506 sq in) or the routed outline (3.005828 sq in): CANNOT DETERMINE - neither service page says. The bounding rectangle is used here, so every OSH Park number on this line is a CEILING by at most $0.0834 per set of three. | Surcharge to hold 0.1500 mm track on a 6 mil process, if any fab will: CANNOT DETERMINE - no fab publishes one.

item: Banana battery-contact PCB - custom, bare board + contacts
exact part (MPN): microduck_banana_contact (this repository's own design; fab package electronics/banana-contact/out/fab/microduck_banana_contact-fab.zip)
identity status: in-house design, DRC verdict CANNOT DETERMINE - the outline and stackup are quotable, the contact part is not
what to do now: Bare board quote, ENIG, 4.6 mm wide strip.
现在怎么做: 裸板报价，沉金，4.6mm 宽条板。
specification for the supplier: QUOTABLE AS A BARE BOARD. Fab package: electronics/banana-contact/out/fab/microduck_banana_contact-fab.zip. Board 45.8000 x 4.6000 mm rounded rectangle, corner radius 0.5000 mm, no internal routing = 0.326555 sq in bounding rectangle (routed outline 210.46 mm2 = 0.326214 sq in). 2 copper layers, FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer copper. SURFACE FINISH ENIG IS REQUIRED, NOT PREFERRED - this board is a sliding spring contact and a solder-coated pad cold-flows and oxidises; quote ENIG explicitly and say so on the quotation. Three 0.8000 mm plated holes for soldered AWG24 leads (1.400 mm pads, 0.300 mm annular ring); minimum copper track 0.4000 mm; the two power tracks are 1.5000 mm wide. The board is only 4.6000 mm across its short axis: please state (a) whether you will run it as a single piece or only in a scored/tab-routed array, (b) the array charge if so, and (c) your rout tolerance on the 4.6000 mm dimension - it enters a measured 4.696 mm pocket with 0.048 mm per side. Quote bare boards at 3 / 100 / 1000 pieces.
open questions: A second fab that will build a 4.6000 mm-wide board AND name ENIG on the order: CANNOT DETERMINE. OSH Park is measured-refused (6.35 mm minimum, short by 1.7500 mm); JLCPCB's 3 x 3 mm minimum and ENIG option fit but it publishes no price for this size. | Array / panel charge for a 45.8 x 4.6 mm board: CANNOT DETERMINE. AdvancedPCB publishes '$50 Lot Charge For Multiple Images Or Step & Repeat' but says nothing about a single small board run in an array. | The spring contact part itself: CANNOT DETERMINE - no manufacturer, no part number, and a contact pitch derived rather than measured. | Current DEMAND through the two 1.5000 mm tracks: CANNOT DETERMINE. The board's CAPACITY is 3.21 A at a 10 degC rise by IPC-2221 6.2; Sony publishes no maximum continuous discharge for the NP-F pack.
